name: KAG: DeRiMV funds by use of the legal limit
description: Every fund of a DeRiMV report with its maximum (or exposure) in % of the legal limit (commitment 100 %, absolute VaR 20 %, relative VaR 200 %), the most used first.

name: KAG: DeRiMV funds per method
description: How many funds of a DeRiMV report use the commitment approach, the absolute and the relative VaR.

name: KAG: DeRiMV absolute VaR above 15 %
description: Funds under the absolute VaR whose maximum of the period is above 15 % (the legal limit is 20 %).

name: KAG: DeRiMV funds near their own limit
description: Funds under the absolute VaR whose maximum of the period uses 90 % or more of the limit of their fund rules (GrenzenGesamtrisiko).
query: /Derivatemeldung/InvestmentFonds[Berechnungsmethode = 'aVaR'][normalize-space(GrenzenGesamtrisiko)][xs:decimal(MaxRisikoangabe) ge 0.9 * xs:decimal(GrenzenGesamtrisiko)] ! string-join((ISIN, FondsName, MaxRisikoangabe || ' of ' || GrenzenGesamtrisiko || ' %'), ' | ')

name: KAG: AIFMD AIF records
description: Every AIF record of an AIF file: national code, name, predominant type, NAV and reporting period.

name: KAG: AIFMD main instruments traded
description: The main instruments of each AIF with ranking, type and position value.

name: KAG: AIFMD geographical focus sums
description: The sums of the NAV and AuM geographical focus percentages of each AIF (each must be 100).

name: KAG: MMF fund reports
description: Every fund report of a money market fund file with its national code and reporting year.
